description: Hermes-LCM is a source-installed Hermes Agent plugin. Hermes Agent owns the Python environment and dependency resolution; the plugin declares the host and optional feature imports it consumes without creating a second package installer or lock.

ownership.update_trigger: Review and increment this contract when the imported-API assurance policy, a scanned runtime import, supported Python or Hermes Agent version, or required imported API changes.

supported_versions.optional_dependency_policy: The supported version is the version resolved by a supported Hermes Agent host when the listed imported API is present. Hermes-LCM does not independently pin or install optional packages.

agent.version_policy: Hermes Agent >=0.16,<1 for the baseline plugin; optional native supervision features additionally require the listed supervision and subagent APIs. Literal-source registration requires the v1 binding fence; final-use and correction callbacks require the matching host API set, including private types. Retrieval presentation is capability-negotiated with baseline fallback. See docs/dependency-assurance.md.

cryptography.scope: redaction stress benchmark only; required for this scenario and its tests
cryptography.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when Ed25519PrivateKey.generate and PKCS8 PEM serialization are available; no import during ordinary plugin use

fastembed.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when fastembed.TextEmbedding accepts model_name, cache_dir, and local_files_only

gateway.version_policy: Hermes Agent >=0.16,<1; falls back to environment metadata when the module is absent

hermes_cli.scope: host home, provider routing, and plugin hook integration
hermes_cli.version_policy: Hermes Agent >=0.16,<1; each compatibility path has an explicit fallback

huggingface_hub.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when huggingface_hub.hf_hub_download accepts repo_id, filename, repo_type, revision, and local_dir

numpy.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when numpy provides frombuffer, zeros, asarray, argpartition, and packbits

regex.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when compiled Pattern.search accepts timeout

tiktoken.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base') is available

yaml.version_policy: host-resolved; supported when yaml.safe_load and yaml.safe_dump are available
